name: Total Defense Shogun
extDescription: This card is changed to Defense Position when it is Normal Summoned or Flip Summoned successfully. This card can attack while in Defense Position. If this card attacks while in Defense Position, apply the ATK of this card for damage calculation.

name: Blade Knight
extDescription: If you have 1 or less cards in your hand, the ATK of this card on the field is increased by 400 points. Also, if this card is the only monster on your side of the field, negate the effects of Flip Effect Monsters destroyed by this card as a result of battle.

name: Command Knight
extDescription: As long as at least 1 other monster exists on your side of the field, your opponent cannot select this card as an attack target. Also, as long as this card remains face up on the field, increase the ATK of all Warrior-Type monsters by 400 points.

name: Swift Gaia the Fierce Knight
extDescription: If this card is the only card in your hand, you can Summon this card in face up attack position without offering monsters as tributes. This is counted as a normal summon.

name: Insect Queen
extDescription: You cannot declare an attack without offering 1 monster on your side of the field as a Tribute. Increase the ATK of this card by 200 points for each face-up Insect-Type monster on your field. Special Summon 1 "Insect Monster Token" (Insect-Type/Earth/1 Star/ATK 100/DEF/ 100) in Attack Position on your side of the field at the end of each turn that this card destroys your opponent's Monster.

name: Obnoxious Celtic Guard
extDescription: This card is not destroyed as a result of battle when this card battles with a monster with an ATK of 1900 or more. (Damage calculation is applied normally.)
